target: Canonical evidence dossiers for studies, experiments, recipes, learning paths, and learning artifacts

contract.purpose: Make every retained PostTrainLLM study and learning artifact independently discoverable without separating conclusions from provenance, limits, or related evidence.
contract.purposeSource: PRODUCT.md, DESIGN.md, PROJECT_STATUS.md, and GitHub Issue #166
contract.canonicalPurpose: PostTrainLLM turns learning into inspectable local artifacts and bounded specialist objectives into evidence-gated Mac-local factory runs.
contract.audience: Learners and practitioners researching Mac-local language-model systems who need a precise, citable record of what was studied, retained, rejected, built, or left unverified.
contract.job: Give each public knowledge object one canonical evidence page with an immediate disposition, substantive explanation, source provenance, limitations, and contextual routes to related work.
contract.thesis: A calm editorial evidence dossier extends the existing research bench: direct headline, restrained verdict strip, readable narrative, and a compact related-evidence rail.
contract.system: Existing deep-ink surfaces, teal verified/action signals, sparse coral warning states, Bricolage display type, Geist prose, Geist Mono evidence labels, 66-72 character reading measure, and one-column mobile reflow.
contract.signature: Every dossier opens with a typed disposition strip and closes the loop through a provenance-first related-evidence rail linking studies, recipes, experiments, paths, and built artifacts.
contract.risk: Templated detail pages could become thin or imply stronger evidence than exists; publication must fail when a record lacks substantive original interpretation, source provenance, limitations, or an explicit lifecycle disposition.

projectCheck.command: pnpm --dir browser test && pnpm --dir browser build

findings: Focused SEO audit reports the existing global SoftwareApplication JSON-LD as ineligible for review-rich results because no review evidence exists; no ratings or reviews were invented.

The broader legacy visual suite still reports a pre-existing 390px overflow on /webgpu-test and an aborted third-party request on /learn; all five new route families passed at 390, 768, and 1440 pixels.

ownerFeedback.note: The owner approved GitHub Issue #166 and explicitly selected Direction A, Evidence dossier.
